description: An atmosphere only experiment following piClim-control, but with the sea surface temperatures that are uniformly 4K warmer and with quadrupled CO2 concentrations (4xCO2) compared to the pre-industrial (1850) value. Sea surface temperatures should be prescribed with a climatology that is 4K warmer, but otherwise identical, to the climatology used in piClim-control. Sea ice concentrations should be prescribed with the same pre-industrial climatology used in piClim-control and all other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions as in piClim-control. In combination with piClim-p4K, piClim-control and piClim-4xCO2, this experiment can be used to evaluate the sensitivity of 4xCO2 radiative forcing to a warmer background state.
